People Ops: FYI — SF office will be on a reduced "quiet week" schedule Mon–Fri June 23–27 while we host a customer summit in parts of the building. Normal access for employees, but some conference rooms and the caf9a will be reserved. Please read travel and desk notes below.
Eli (Facilities): Rooms reserved: Main Conf C, D, and the caf9a area will be used for summit booths Tue–Thu. Free hot desks on floors 2 and 5; quiet rooms 2B and 5A kept for staff.
Samira: Quick Q — I have external visitor on Wednesday morning. Any visitor policy changes?
People Ops: Visitor check-in: all external guests must be registered via the guest form and wear a visitor badge. If bringing clients, register 48h in advance so security can pre-clear.
Noah: Will there be extra noise from vendors? I need a quiet space for a podcast recording on Wed.
Eli (Facilities): There will be vendor load-in Mon night and light booth setup Tue morning. We can reserve 5A quiet room for your recording. DM me with preferred time.
Travel Bot: Shuttle update: no change to usual commute shuttles. We added one extra drop at 8:45am Thu due to higher expected attendance.
Maddie: Any change to catering? I have strict dietary needs.
People Ops: Catering for staff will be limited to breakfast items Mon–Thu and boxed lunches on Tue/Thu. Please list dietary restrictions on this form: https://forms.redwood.ai/summit-staffing. Staff not attending onsite may WFH — mark WFH in the form so we can adjust food counts.
Samira: And badge access?
People Ops: Badges work as normal. Some turnstiles may be temporarily repurposed for guest flow; signage and security will guide you.
Noah: If someone needs to book a nearby hotel because they have back-to-back external meetings, is there support?
People Ops: We can approve a one-night hotel stipend up to $160 for staff with verified external meeting schedules. Submit receipt to Expensify with tag "summit-sf-2026". Ask your manager for pre-approval.
Eli (Facilities): Accessibility note: there will be an accessible route to the event spaces and dedicated seating. If you need additional accommodations, DM People Ops and we'll coordinate with the venue.
People Ops: Final: we'll post a map + reserved area list by next Monday and update this thread if anything changes. Thanks! :party_popper:
